title: Prescriber, Weight-Record and Ship-To Requirements by Tailwise Pharmacy Class
content:
Some Tailwise Pharmacy classes carry requirements on who may prescribe, on the pet's recorded weight, and on where the medication may be shipped. The table states each requirement for all six classes.

| Class | Prescriber must hold a DEA registration | Weight-band check before authorization is requested | Weight record must be no older than | Shipping states not served |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Rx Preventive | No | Yes | 12 calendar months | none |
| Rx Maintenance Medication | No | No | 12 calendar months | none |
| Rx Prescription Diet | No | No | 12 calendar months | none |
| Rx Short-Course Medication | No | No | 12 calendar months | none |
| Rx Controlled Substance | Yes | Yes | 6 calendar months | AK, HI, NV |
| Rx Compounded Medication | No | Yes | 6 calendar months | AK, HI |

## Definitions

- **DEA registration**: whether the prescribing veterinarian must hold a DEA registration. The veterinarian's record at Tailwise shows whether the veterinarian is DEA registered.
- **Weight-band check**: whether the pet's recorded weight must fall in the product's labeled weight band before authorization is requested.
- **Weight record age**: a weight used for the weight-band check must have been recorded within this many calendar months of the order date. The age limit matters only for a class that carries the weight-band check.
- **Shipping states not served**: two-letter shipping states to which the class is not dispensed. The customer's shipping state on the profile is the state compared.

## Points of reading

- Only Rx Controlled Substance requires a DEA-registered prescriber.
- Rx Controlled Substance is not dispensed to Alaska (AK), Hawaii (HI) or Nevada (NV); Rx Compounded Medication is not dispensed to Alaska (AK) or Hawaii (HI). The other four classes list no restricted state.
- Rx Preventive, Rx Controlled Substance and Rx Compounded Medication carry the weight-band check; for the first the weight may be up to 12 calendar months old, for the other two up to 6 calendar months old.
